summary: Golar LNG Ltd furnished a Form 6-K attaching a September 21, 2026 press release announcing fixed income investor meetings starting that day, with a possible benchmark USD 144A/Reg S senior unsecured notes offering subject to market conditions. No price, size, coupon, or maturity is stated. A bank syndicate is mandated; the notes would be unsecured obligations of the issuer, with no board recommendation or special-situation mechanics. This is an ordinary debt capital-markets marketing step, not a special situation; watch for pricing terms, size, and use of proceeds as the risk-arb angle.
